text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation, where machines do tasks that people used to do, like sorting data or answering customer questions. Companies also use AI productivity tools to save time and reduce mistakes. However, AI is not only about replacing workers. In many jobs, human-AI collaboration works best, because people and machines have different strengths. This means some jobs may disappear, while new ones appear. Workers now need to learn new skills to work well with AI. In short, AI brings both challenges and chances, and adapting to it is important for everyone.
